notes: Copula *are* placed on נַחֲלַת as the predicate the ASV reads indefinitely (*a heritage*), with בָּנִים the subject; competing reading would treat the definite construct chain as subject and put the copula on בָּנִים. Second colon parallel: שָׂכָר is the indefinite predicate and takes *is*, discontinuous around the supplied *his*.
*the fruit of the womb*: rectum rendered arthrously, so the article takes the *the* before its own word and פְּרִי takes a supplied *the* (rule 29).
